summary: A Pennsylvania State Police corporal was charged after investigators found thousands of pornographic files on his work computer, some made with deepfake software. He was suspended and the investigation continues.
technical_summary: Investigators seized a work computer holding thousands of pornographic files, some bearing evidence of creation with deepfake software. The charges concern misuse of government equipment; the reports do not say whether real people were depicted.

sector.quote: A Pennsylvania State Police Corporal was charged after allegedly using his work computer to store thousands of pornographic images

technology.quote: Investigators discovered that some of the pornographic media files contained evidence that they were made using deepfake software.

notes: No identified victims or depicted individuals are reported; charges concern misuse of a work computer. Allegations only.

summary: A National Weather Service office posted a wind forecast map for Idaho with invented and misspelled town names created with generative AI. The post was deleted and corrected after journalists asked about it.
technical_summary: A local NWS office used a generative AI tool to create a base map for a forecast graphic. The model fabricated place names and misspellings, and the image was published without review or an experimental label before being withdrawn.

technology.quote: that the agency confirmed were linked to the use of generative AI

harm_type.quote: Experts worry that without properly trained officials, mistakes could erode trust in the agency and the technology.

summary: A Google search for the 'ugliest language in India' returned Kannada in a featured answer box, causing outrage among Kannada speakers and politicians. Google apologized and removed the answer.
technical_summary: Google's featured snippet algorithm extracted an opinion from an obscure third-party website and presented it as a factual answer to a prejudiced query. It amplified existing demeaning content without source credibility checks.

failure_mode.quote: an existing opinion that Google wrongly amplified

harm_type.quote: as the answer late last week, causing widespread outrage

notes: The source website was reportedly obscure and possibly deliberately seeded.

summary: Europol's 2025 threat assessment warns that criminal networks are using AI for scams, impersonation, blackmail and child sexual abuse material, and that AI makes their operations cheaper, more scalable and harder to detect.
technical_summary: Organized crime groups apply generative AI to craft multilingual phishing messages, realistic impersonations and abuse imagery, and to automate operations. Europol warns that autonomous AI could eventually enable AI-controlled criminal networks.

technology.quote: Criminals are also using generative artificial intelligence to produce child sexual abuse material

failure_mode.quote: Organised crime gangs are turning to AI-powered scams and payment systems to target victims

notes: Threat assessment of a broad trend rather than a single discrete event.

summary: Sixteen young women at a Valencia educational institute complained that AI-generated nude images of them were circulating online. Police investigated a 17-year-old male classmate for allegedly creating and selling them.
technical_summary: Original photos of female students were manipulated with AI to appear naked, and the images were shared through social media accounts, some created in the victims' names. Police traced IP addresses used to set up the accounts to a student.

failure_mode.quote: investigating a 17-year-old on suspicion of using artificial intelligence to deepfake nude images of female classmates

harm_type.quote: Photos of various people, all of them minors, appeared on this account.

affected_population.quote: Photos of various people, all of them minors, appeared on this account.

notes: Suspect is a minor under investigation; allegations only.

summary: South African social grant recipients reported repeated failures of the facial recognition step in the agency's online certification portal. Grants can be suspended if verification is not completed, and users were redirected to in-person checks.
technical_summary: SASSA's eLife certification used facial recognition and one-time pins, and beneficiaries, many of them pensioners, reported repeated verification failures and downtime. The agency attributed problems to dependencies on other systems and older ID documents.

technology.quote: beneficiaries cite consistent failures with facial recognition and one-time pins (OTPs)

failure_mode.quote: beneficiaries cite consistent failures with facial recognition and one-time pins (OTPs)

harm_type.quote: Beneficiaries who fail to complete the process risk having their grants suspended.

notes: How many grant suspensions resulted from facial verification failures is not specified.

summary: Security researchers and the FBI warned of a phishing campaign using AI deepfake robocalls and fake emails to trick Gmail users into giving up recovery codes and credentials, enabling account takeover and fraud.
technical_summary: Attackers combine AI-generated robocalls claiming account compromise with convincing emails from look-alike Google domains and fake login pages. The AI lowers cost and improves filter evasion, letting criminals steal recovery codes, credentials and session cookies.

technology.quote: The attack uses AI to craft deepfake robocalls and malicious emails capable of bypassing security filters.

failure_mode.quote: The attack uses AI to craft deepfake robocalls and malicious emails capable of bypassing security filters.

harm_type.quote: These sophisticated tactics can result in devastating financial losses, reputational damage, and compromise of sensitive data.

notes: The claim that billions of users were targeted reflects media framing of a warning; actual victim numbers are not given.

summary: A viral video appeared to show Zambia's president announcing he would not seek re-election in 2026. Fact-checkers found it was AI-generated, and police opened an investigation into its creator.
technical_summary: A manipulated video, watermarked from a TikTok account that posts AI-generated political content, animated the president's face to deliver a fabricated announcement. Visual cues such as a motionless body and fact-checks exposed the fake after it spread on several platforms.

technology.quote: The video was fabricated using artificial intelligence, and has been debunked by multiple experts.

harm_type.quote: claim to show a video of Zambian president Hakainde Hichilema announcing that he will not run for re-election

summary: Drake released a track using AI-generated voices of Tupac Shakur and Snoop Dogg. Shakur's estate sent a cease-and-desist letter and Drake removed the song, though it remained available elsewhere.
technical_summary: A voice-cloning model was used to imitate two rappers' voices on a new diss track. Rights holders objected on publicity and copyright grounds, since creating the imitation likely required training on the artist's recordings without authorization.

technology.quote: The track, released in April, featured the AI-generated voices of Snoop Dogg and Shakur

failure_mode.quote: after receiving a cease-and-desist letter from Shakur's estate

summary: New Zealand's financial regulator warned of a global pump-and-dump scam using deepfake videos of well-known business leaders in social media ads to lure investors into WhatsApp groups. Multiple victims lost significant sums.
technical_summary: Scammers used AI-generated impersonations of business leaders in Facebook and Instagram ads to funnel victims into chat groups that pushed low-value foreign shares, then ran a follow-on compensation scam to extract more money and personal data.

harm_type.quote: with multiple victims having lost significant amounts

severity.quote: with multiple victims having lost significant amounts

summary: A US federal appeals court sanctioned two attorneys for more than two dozen fake citations and misrepresentations in appellate briefs that bore hallmarks of AI hallucinations. The attorneys did not answer whether AI was used and deny the allegations.
technical_summary: Briefs contained fabricated cases, quotations absent from cited sources and unsupported propositions, patterns associated with generative AI hallucination. The court found the conduct sanctionable regardless of the tool; the attorneys did not disclose how the briefs were prepared.

failure_mode.quote: The court said it found more than two dozen fake citations and misrepresentations of fact in the appeal

harm_type.quote: sullied the reputation of our bar, which now must litigate under the cloud of their conduct

notes: AI use is not confirmed; the attorneys deny fabricating citations.

summary: A Tesla Model 3 using Autopilot hit a parked police car on a Connecticut interstate, then struck a disabled vehicle. The driver admitted he was not watching the road. No one was seriously injured.
technical_summary: Tesla's driver-assistance system failed to avoid stopped emergency vehicles with flashing lights while the driver was inattentive and relying on it, a recurring pattern combining perception limits with over-reliance on partial automation.

technology.quote: inattentive driver in a Tesla Model 3 using Autopilot

failure_mode.quote: was not paying attention to the road, but relying on the Tesla system

severity.quote: Fortunately, no one involved was seriously injured
